entry.intro: Write one-word clues for a secret word that the guesser cannot see. The clues that match are cancelled. You get a code to share.

leaveConfirm: You will not be able to come back.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends.

settings.total: {count} turn in all with {players} players. Everyone takes turns as the guesser. | {count} turns in all with {players} players. Everyone takes turns as the guesser.

table.thinking: Clues are being written. Have a think about what the word could be.

status.wins: {names} wins with {score} points. | {names} win with {score} points.
status.revealBest: {name} got it! {best}'s hint was the best.
status.revealNoHint: {name} got it! Every hint was cancelled.
status.guesserWriting: You are the guesser. The others are writing clues ({written} of {total}).
status.write: Write a one-word clue for “{word}”. If somebody writes the same, both are cancelled.
status.clueSent: Clue sent. Waiting for the others ({written} of {total}).
status.yourGuess: Your turn: read the clues and guess the word, or pass.
status.pickBest: Right! Now pick the best hint.
status.choosing: {name} found the word, and is picking the best hint.
status.abandonedNote: Too many players left, so this game does not count towards the statistics.
status.leaveToMenu: Use Leave game (top right) to go back to the menu.
status.finishedNote: Use Leave game (top right) to go back to the menu, or "All rounds" in the score bar to see every turn again.
status.waitingReadyNext: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the next turn.
status.waitingReadyFinal: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the final scores.
status.closeScores: Close the scores when you are ready to carry on.
status.ownCancelled: Your clue was cancelled: it matched another one.
status.scoring: Right: {guesser} points for you, and {bestHint} for the writer of the best hint. Wrong or pass: nobody scores.
status.clickBest: Click the clue that helped you most.

log.turnStart: Turn {n} of {total}: {name} is the guesser. Everyone else is writing a clue.
log.cluesIn: The clues are in. None of them matched. | The clues are in. {count} matched and was cancelled. | The clues are in. {count} matched and were cancelled.
log.noHints: {name} scores {score}. No hints were left to pick from.
log.gameOver: The game is over: {names} wins. | The game is over: {names} win.

errors.guesserNoClue: You are guessing, so you do not write a clue.
errors.alreadyClued: You have already sent your clue.
errors.clueTooLong: A clue is at most {max} letters.
errors.clueIsTheWord: That is the word itself, or part of it.
errors.noBestYet: There is no best hint to pick yet.
errors.guesserOnlyPicks: Only the guesser picks the best hint.
